description: Co-pilot answers GTA 6 questions with sources (Rockstar, guide sites, guide videos) and says when something isn't confirmed. Free players get 2 answers a day (20 a day for everyone until 21 Nov 2026, 11:00 UTC); Sunset Strip Plus (monthly or yearly, founder price until 28 Nov) removes the limit and adds answer alerts and private map pins. Returns prices, dates and links.
name: get_copilot_and_plus
title: Co-pilot and Sunset Strip Plus
